description: Self-test memory end to end: data-dir writability, a scratch-bank write/read/delete roundtrip, sibling reachability (router, session-manager, state), whether embeddings answer, whether recent extraction passes failed, which model extraction calls and why, how many extraction jobs wait in the dead-letter queue, and what extraction spent (model calls, tokens, the router's cost) and wrote since boot. Reports degraded states explicitly, not a bare process-up health.

PassHealth.description: How passes have gone since boot, for `memory::doctor`: a pass that fails every time is otherwise only a log line.

failed_in_a_row.description: Passes failed since the last one that succeeded.

pending.description: Passes that ended with runs left for the queue's retry: a backlog draining, not a failure.

PassTally.description: What extraction spent and wrote: model calls, the usage the router reported for them, memory effects, and returned memories not written.

continuations.description: Calls made after one whose memories reached `max_memories_per_turn`, asking the same piece for what it left out; failed ones included. Each is also in `calls`.

cost_usd.description: The router's own cost, summed over the calls that carried one; absent when none did.

dropped.description: Memories the model returned that were not written, by reason, and items that did not parse, as `malformed`. A rule item that parsed is counted in `rules` only.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens the router reported, cached ones included.

no_array.description: Replies with no JSON array (prose, one word, no text); a `[]` reply is not one. A piece's first call is asked once more after one, and a second reads as nothing to keep; a continuation's is not asked again and leaves the piece `saturated`.

returned.description: Items in the replies' arrays before any check: memories, rules and malformed ones.

rules.description: Of `returned`, the rule items: they become learned rule lines, never memories, so `created` and `dropped` never count them.

saturated.description: Pieces that ended at the cap: the last reply read still reached `max_memories_per_turn` and no further call was made or could be read. The model may have left facts out, and nothing else shows that.

extraction.description: Extraction passes since boot: how they went, what the model calls cost and what they wrote.

ok.description: True only when every REQUIRED check passed (the store roundtrip; the rest are reported but advisory).
